soru: What did Mr Vasiliev's sign say?
secenekler: Beat me and win 50 lira. Lose and pay 10.
kanit: Beat me and win 50 lira. Lose and pay 10.

soru: What did Selin have to do in the free games?
tr: Selin ücretsiz oyunlarda ne yapmak zorundaydı?
kanit: But you have to explain every move before you make it. Out loud.

soru: What did he say a good player should be?
tr: İyi bir oyuncunun nasıl olması gerektiğini söyledi?
kanit: A good player is suspicious of good ideas.

soru: What place did Selin get in the national championship?
kanit: but she came fourth, out of more than three hundred players

soru: What did Mr Vasiliev write on the other side of the sign?
tr: Bay Vasiliev tabelanın arkasına ne yazdı?
